$schema_note: Registry of build-in-public projects. Single source of truth for status and Work-page graduation. status 'active' shows under Building; status 'shipped' + a `work` object also renders on the main Work page (merged by lib/portfolio.ts).

projects.title: RegWatch
projects.tagline: Google Alerts for the Diário Oficial da União (DOU)
projects.blurb: A monitoring service that watches Brazil's federal gazette (the DOU) and alerts professional-services firms when their clients or topics are mentioned.

projects.title: ReplayGate
projects.tagline: Cross-turn regression testing for multi-turn, channel-native AI agents
projects.blurb: Records a real agent conversation, its LLM and tool calls, into a deterministic fixture, then replays it to catch the cross-turn bugs per-turn tests miss.

projects.title: Turmarium
projects.tagline: Multi-tenant school-management SaaS with tenant isolation enforced in the database
projects.blurb: A B2B SaaS for schools: people, disciplines, terms, turmas, grades and attendance. A Django modular monolith with tenant isolation enforced by Postgres RLS.

projects.title: stealthbench
projects.tagline: A reproducible benchmark that puts numbers on browser-automation stealth
projects.blurb: Scores browser-automation stealth configs against self-hosted bot detectors on your own localhost. It measures detectability only, and every detector runs offline.

projects.title: supskill
projects.tagline: A sprint conductor for Claude Code
projects.blurb: Drives one sprint from a markdown backlog to a merged branch: a fresh context boundary at every stage, three human gates, and all authoritative state kept on disk.
